header.running_head: The Monetary Gifts that Hadhrat Umar (RA) Gave

blocks.text: Hadhrat Umar (RA) Reverts to the Opinion of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and Hadhrat Ali (RA) Concerning the Distribution of Wealth

Hadhrat Umar bin Abdullaah (RA) the freed slave of Ghafra reports that when Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away, plenty of wealth arrived from Bahrain. He then narrated the entire narration as has appeared earlier[^1]. The narration also mentions that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once came out for the Jumu'ah salaah and after praising Allaah, he addressed the people saying, "The news has reached me that some of you have said that when Umar dies (or they said when the Ameerul Mu'mineen dies), we will instantly pledge allegiance to a certain person just as people instantly pledged allegiance to Abu Bakr (RA). There is no doubt that the pledge of allegiance to Abu Bakr (RA) took place very suddenly, but where will we find another person like Abu Bakr (RA) to whom we would be prepared to fully submit ourselves as we did for Abu Bakr (RA)? Abu Bakr (RA) was of the opinion that the distribution of wealth should be with total equality whereas my opinion was that some people be given more. However, if I live this year, I shall switch to the opinion of Abu Bakr (RA) because his opinion is better then mine." The narration still continues further.[^2]
The Monetary Gifts that Hadhrat Umar (RA) Gave
Hadhrat Umar (RA) Gives Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) What Remained in the Baytul Maal

Hadhrat Hasan reports that once after Hadhrat Umar (RA) had distributed money amongst the people, there was still some left over in the Baytul Maal. Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) then said to Hadhrat Umar (RA) and the people there, "Tell me if the uncle of Moosa (AS) was living amongst you, would you honour him?" "Certainly," they all replied. He then said, "Then I am more deserving of the honour for I am the uncle of your Nabi ﷺ." After discussing with the others, Hadhrat Umar (RA) then gave the remaining amount to Hadhrat Abbaas (RA).[^3]
The Narration of Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) in this Regard

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) narrates that when a perfume holder once came to Hadhrat Umar (RA), those around him looked at him to see whom he would give it to. He said, "Would you permit me to send this to Aa'isha (RA) because of the love that Rasulullaah ﷺ had for her?" When they agreed, it was brought
Under the heading "The Manner in which Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) Distributed Wealth" and the subheading "The Incident of the Wealth that Arrived from Bahrain".
Bazzaar. Haythami (Vol.6 Pg.6) has commented on the chain of narrators.
